answer: A fake cluster of identities can only bridge into the economy by paying full bond per node, so forging N sybils costs N times the stake, often more than any fable of easy profit. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond to register, and peers attest work at a periodic summit where reputation is reviewed. Slashing on proven fraud makes mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
